scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A marked tensor obstruction to four-dimensional disk embedding” (preprints/A-marked-tensor-obstruction-to-four-dimensional-disk-embedding-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 305 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6453a6d9ab0cf566), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist a compact connected oriented smooth four-manifold M with boundary, an integer k ≥ 1, generically immersed proper disks f1, . . . , fk : (D2 , S1 ) −→ (M, ∂M) with disjoint embedded boundary circles, and generically immersed framed spheres g1, . . . , gk : S2 −→ M, such that λ(fi, gj) = δij, λ(gi, gj) = 0 for all i, j, ̃ µ(gi) = 0 for all i, but there are no pairwise disjoint locally flat embedded disks in M with the same boundary maps and the boundary normal framings induced by the fi.
